name: termio
description: SSH terminal for slow and distant links

scripts.android: cargo ndk -t arm64-v8a build --release -p termio-core && tarve build app/main.tsx --target android-arm64 --outfile dist/Termio.apk
scripts.android:install: bun run android && adb install -r dist/Termio.apk && adb shell monkey -p termio.app -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1
scripts.check:perf: cargo test --release -p termio-core flood -- --nocapture && cargo test --release -p termio-agent --test agent flood -- --nocapture && bun scripts/terminal-check.tsx
scripts.check: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && tsc --noEmit && bun test && bun run check:perf
scripts.agent:linux: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc "cargo build --release -p termio-agent --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl && mkdir -p dist/agent && strip -o dist/agent/termio-agent-linux-x64 target/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/release/termio-agent"
scripts.build: cargo build --release -p termio-core && tarve build app/desktop.tsx --runtime txiki --outfile dist/Termio.exe

tarve.name: Termio
tarve.description: SSH terminal for slow and distant links
